item.title: NEW: 🇺🇸 A bill to write the Strategic Bitcoin Reserve into law now heads to th…
item.description: NEW: 🇺🇸 A bill to write the Strategic Bitcoin Reserve into law now heads to the full House after the House Financial Services Committee formally reports it. It bars the government from selling, swapping, auctioning or encumbering its Bitcoin for at least 20 years and requires proof-of-reserve reports. Addresses linked to the U.S. government hold 306.8K BTC, worth over $18.7B, per Arkham. Time is short: this Congress ends January 3, and Polymarket gives a national reserve under 5% odds before 2027. Without the bill, a future president can undo Trump's executive order alone. Source: https://x.com/BitcoinNewsCom/status/2125990010159571011

item.title: NEW: 🇺🇸 Eric Trump's American Bitcoin takes a $150M credit line from FalconX, …
item.description: NEW: 🇺🇸 Eric Trump's American Bitcoin takes a $150M credit line from FalconX, secured by its own Bitcoin. The two-year revolving facility carries a 5.95% loan fee and a 143% initial collateral ratio, so every $1 drawn needs about $1.43 in pledged BTC. CEO Mike Ho calls it non-dilutive capital, letting the miner fund growth without selling from a reserve of more than 8.5K BTC. ABTC jumps 17% Monday to about $4.09, yet the stock is still down roughly 84% this year. Source: https://x.com/BitcoinNewsCom/status/2125628434059592060
